triggerComment: The obligation to notify was triggered by an acquisition of shares and collateral (Acquisition Position Obligation). With Recommendations of the Disclosure Office dated 15 July 2016, 17 June 2019, 8 July 2022 and 11 July 2025, BlackRock, Inc. was granted easing provisions from the obligation to disclose the direct shareholders according to Article 120 para. 1 FinMIA in conjunction with Article 11 let. b and Article 22 para. 1 let. e and para. 3 FinMIO-FINMA when disclosing holdings according to Article 18 para. 1 and 4 FinMIO-FINMA. However, collective investment schemes within the meaning of Article 18 para. 2 let. a FinMIO-FINMA that hold individually 3% or more of the voting rights of the relevant issuer will be mentioned in the relevant disclosure notification. Any person shall, at his/her request and without prove of interest, receive information about the direct shareholders within the meaning of Article 11 let. b an Article 22 para. 1 let. e and para. 3 FinMIO-FINMA.  Such request has to be addressed via email to the Disclosure Office: disclosure-office@six-group.com. The information will be provided in electronic format with a reference date not older than one month.  The easing provisions are granted until 15 July 2028.

triggerComment: The call options disclosed in the section “Part 5: SALE POSITIONS” concerning MindMaze shares were included in the wake of related communication with the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA).

The existence, scope and substance of the call options disclosed in the section “Part 5: SALE POSITIONS” concerning MindMaze shares are disputed between Flow Enterprises SA and BFG Partners International Ltd. Flow Enterprises SA is of the view that such call options have never been agreed upon between the parties, which was confirmed by the Geneva Court of First Instance in interim measures proceedings. The disclosure of the call options is made according to the disclosure notice of BFG Partners International Ltd. dated 16 July 2026, exclusively to enhance market transparency, without prejudice and without acknowledgement of any legal position or disclosure obligation.
